//: Typechecks the SERVER source, the tests, and the hand-written
declarations together, so the two cannot drift: src/ imports its public
types from types/, which means a shape added to the source without a
matching declaration is a compile error. types/test-d.ts exercises the
noEmit is deliberate — tsup emits, tsc only judges.
The SPA has its OWN tsconfig (src/ui/tsconfig.json) because Vite
resolves imports like a bundler and Node does not. `npm run
typecheck` runs both; running only this one leaves the UI unchecked.
